title: Explicit ledger-owner identity remediation
remediation_scope: add an explicit positive owner_instance_id to energy-ledger trial preparation
bind prepared handles and ledger-owned prepared scratch to owner_instance_id in addition to generation, lineage, revision and interval
reject cross-owner prepared handles fail-closed without consuming either ledger
preserve accepted-receipt, rollback, energy-conservation and F-KT18 mass semantics
avoid hidden module-global counters, pointer identity, random identity or clock-derived identity

owner_identity_contract.required_property: positive and unique among simultaneously live logical ledger owners

hard_nonclaims: not proof that a future production MultiSWAP runtime assigns owner_instance_id values uniquely
next_owner: read-only owner postimage qualification, then fresh independent qualification including explicit owner-id contract limitation
